revision.note: every claim in this file belongs to this revision; the raw logs in raw/ carry the readings verbatim

acceptance.clause: The harness-owned closure notes are checked as claims: each of T-21/T-23/T-24/T-26/T-43 has a note where an agent meets it, the T-23/T-24 helper is executed once successfully, and the T-43 guard's negative case (it must not fire for a normal session) is shown.

notes_where_an_agent_meets_them.AGENTS.md: SS12 'Harness-owned frictions - CLOSED by a rule plus a helper' carries an id-labelled bullet for each of T-21 / T-23 / T-24 / T-26 / T-43 (+ T-54 / T-55) and names the one-command fallback for each; lines 521/524/527/530/532/535/537 (line numbers cited as the NOTE's location, never as code provenance - T-55).
notes_where_an_agent_meets_them.agent-references/troubleshooting.md: the symptom-first table carries the detail: row 15 T-21 (id in row), row 17 T-23 (detail present, id ABSENT - F-2), row 29 T-24 (id in row), row 30 T-26 (id in row), row 31 T-43 (id in row).
notes_where_an_agent_meets_them.reachability: two independent routes: the id (AGENTS.md SS12 -> 'the detail lives in agent-references/troubleshooting.md') and the SYMPTOM (grep nohup / mpd-bg / reload-check / check-write / real-home hits the right row).

readings: log content: HELPER-REAL-RUN-DONE (the child really ran and really wrote the workspace log)
[mpd-bg] RUNNING pid=15   (second, correct probe target: probe.log.pid)

[mpd-bg] NO-PID-FILE .../helper.pid  (the FIRST attempt probed the wrong filename <log-without-.log>.pid - the helper writes <log>.pid; that NO-PID-FILE exit-2 reading is itself the documented arm, not a helper failure)

t43_negative_case.on_disk: the two sandbox cases (refusal + deliberate override) live in evidence/platform/harness-close/

acceptance.clause: T-50 is re-verified for what it actually claims - the resolution is lazy and the warning wording is honest; the absent observation (six clean boots) is restated as a bound, never as a fix for an observed failure.

consumers: packages/mpd-roles-plugin/src/index.ts -> const dsh = createLazyDshAdapter(ctx, { label: 'mpd-roles', warn: adapterWarn })
lazy_resolution.mechanism: a Proxy whose get() calls resolve() per property access; resolve() probes the service on EVERY use and caches ONLY a successful mount (mounted / temporary), so a row that applies before its provider activates still picks the mounted adapter up on the next call

honest_wording.transient_miss: 'ADAPTER NOT YET ACTIVE: ... its provider fiber is not ACTIVE yet ... this transient miss needs NO row-order change (T-50).' - reached when a NON-strict probe still finds the service (registered, starting)
honest_wording.provably_absent: 'ADAPTER FALLBACK (adapterIdentity=...): ... fix the ROW ORDER (this row must sit BELOW mpd-dsh-adapter)' - reached only on a strict+non-strict miss, i.e. proof of absence; the two modes are separated by probeMpdDsh(ctx,false).missing (comment at the branch, ADAPTER_IDENTITY_PENDING = 'pending:provider-not-active')

evidence.suites: bun test: mpd-dsh-adapter-plugin 42 pass / 0 fail (137 expect); mpd-ext-plugin 74 pass / 0 fail (560 expect); mpd-roles-plugin 31 pass / 0 fail (485 expect) - all three exit 0
evidence.bound: the register's own bound, restated as a bound and NOT as a fix for an observed failure: 'six consecutive clean boots on the correctly ordered tree never opened the window (t24, 6/6 adapterIdentity=mounted:mpdDsh, zero fallback lines) - so this change is justified by the code' (evidence/platform/lazy-adapter/20260917T012724Z/result.json). One live run window cannot prove the transient window is unreachable; it proves the fix does not regress the ordered case.

findings.text: row 17 (the T-23 symptom row: nohup / bwrap --die-with-parent / the mpd-bg run+probe shape) is the ONLY one of the five harness-close rows that does not carry its friction id in the row: rows 15/29/30/31 say (T-21)/(T-24)/(T-26)/(T-43) but row 17 says none. An id-search for 'T-23' in that file returns 0 hits.
findings.requiredFix: append ' (T-23)' to row 17 (one-line doc edit; the AGENTS.md SS12 bullet for T-23 already carries the id, and the row is reachable by its symptom, so this is cosmetic, not a knowledge gap).
findings.impact: none on any reading in this file; the detail is discoverable by symptom keyword and the id route lands on the row's topic.

verdict: PASS - acceptance A4 (with cosmetic F-2) and A5 hold on the revision measured; nothing in the harness-close note set is a false claim.
bound: the note set, the helper behaviour and the T-50 mechanism were measured on HEAD 646d801 + the working tree at the times stamped here; a later writer to scripts/mpd-bg.mjs, AGENTS.md, agent-references/troubleshooting.md or the adapter/ext/roles sources invalidates the corresponding reading.
